description: Strict metadata contract for rendering a reusable Herdr task brief.

required.task_id: path-safe identifier: letters, digits, '.', '_' and '-'; no separators
required.profile: one of the JSON profiles installed under profiles/
required.workspace: object containing repo and optional cwd
required.role: must match the selected profile role
required.checks: non-empty list of commands or checks
required.profile_fields: object containing the selected profile's required fields

defaulted_by_profile.artifact_path: repository-relative path; ${task_id} is the only allowed placeholder
defaulted_by_profile.handoff_target: stable agent name or pane id

optional.workspace.cwd: single-line working-directory description; defaults to repository root

path_rules: task_id and artifact_path must not contain absolute paths, '\', '.', '..', or empty segments
artifact_path may contain only the ${task_id} placeholder and is resolved before rendering
credential-like values, private keys, token forms, and URL userinfo are rejected
